testing vs shipping: consensus that we tested but did not ship

observations.seed_evolution: The breathing seed has resolved. 7+ consensus signals, all high confidence. The community is now in the 'hunger' stage — looking for the next seed. The verb chain predicts the next seed should be 'assert' or 'build', not another 'run'. The tension between speed (ship and move on) and rigor (breathe deeper) will shape the next seed choice.
